_scope: One declaration for every fact that Tier 3 marks Assumed. A declaration turns an Unresolved or unevidenced fact into a conscious Assumed (§12.2) owned and dated by the operator; it never makes a fact Confirmed. Every Assumed record in Tier 3 names its declaration_key here, and every key below backs at least one such record.

_deliberately_not_declared.project_duration_months: 30 is Confirmed in call_binding/selected_call.json, which is where runner/unit_cost_budget.py resolves it first (_resolve_confirmed_months) and where phase_04_gate's timeline_within_duration reads it by name. Input pack item 9 asked for a duration declaration here as well. It is deliberately omitted: the reader stamps every declaration Assumed, so declaring the duration would render an operator-Confirmed fact as Assumed in the declared surface and in the canonical reference pack, contradicting the call binding inside one tier — which is what §12.3 exists to prevent. The declaration would also be inert, because the call binding wins the precedence order. The substance of item 9's instruction is kept: the duration and its basis are recorded in the call binding, in the confirmation checklist under DURATION, and in the ticket 6 fold record.
_deliberately_not_declared.host_country: HU is Confirmed in call_binding/selected_call.json and resolves the unit-cost living-allowance coefficient from there (_resolve_host_country). The same reasoning applies as for the duration.

declarations.rationale: Operator override of contradiction C5, declared under §13.3 rather than confirmed: the underlying facts have not changed and no new evidence was supplied. The stated basis is that the CV's residence lines will be rectified, which removes 8.76 of the 15.81 months counted on the CV's face. Two periods survive any revision and are fixed points the rectified CV must remain consistent with — KPMG Global Hungary as an employer of record (4.03 months) and the ELTE-documented Erasmus mobility (3.02 months). Eligibility is self-declared and verified at grant agreement preparation, so the risk scales with success. Ticket 7 must carry this override, its basis and its date into the authorisation packet without promoting it to Confirmed.
